qa_pairs.question: Which engine types use the torque sequence with 50 Nm, 80 Nm, 15 min setting time, then 100 Nm?
What is the difference in the tightening procedure between S14/S38 B35 and S38 B36/S38 B38 cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: S14/S38 B35 uses a torque sequence (50 Nm, 80 Nm, 15 min setting time, 100 Nm), while S38 B36/S38 B38 uses torque plus angle method (20 Nm, then 60°, then 70°)
